title: KNICKS SHOCK! Draft Pick STAYS in Germany — Tyler Kolek's Roster Spot Just CHANGED!
description:
The Knicks' first draft pick as reigning champions just signed a five-year extension with Alba Berlin — and it changes everything for Tyler Kolek's roster spot. We break down what it means for the depth chart, why the Miles McBride trade math does not work, and why analysts are pointing at a dunk contest champion to solve the center problem.

Mike Brown's history with young players, the second apron reality shaping every decision Leon Rose can make, and the disciplined version of a McBride trade that would actually help New York.

Which move would you actually make? Tell us in the comments.
